summary: Kamada Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing a three-year $50 million commercial sales agreement to supply normal source plasma from its Texas collection centers to an undisclosed biopharmaceutical company. Initial sales are expected in Q4 2026. No change of control or shareholder vote is involved; the filing is a routine business contract update. Under US-equivalent reporting, this is an ordinary course disclosure of a supply agreement, not a special situation. No deal terms such as price per share or premium apply.
